notes.title: Medieval China or gnomish caves? You decide!
notes.content:
With this bundle, you’ll discover that strategic skills can be flexed no matter the setting! Venture deep underground or transport yourself to medieval China with this Everdream Village and Chinese Frontiers bundle and become a master city builder!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44313274/bef7feedbe9e173371e275086c3d8bd0ef5d384b.png

About this bundle:

From gnome caves to great walls — build your legacy!

Get ready to build big and dig deep in this inventive strategy bundle!

In EcoGnomix, you'll guide a quirky team of gnomes as they loot mystical caves in roguelite-style runs to power up your evolving city above ground. Every expedition into the depths unlocks new upgrades, resources, and surprises that help your gnome civilization thrive.

Switch from underground charm to historical grandeur in Chinese Frontiers, where you'll manage a growing village in medieval China. Lead your people, assign tasks, and construct the legendary Great Wall itself, all while making choices that echo across your empire's future.

Both games combine creative building with strategic decision-making in totally unique ways. Whether you're carving out tunnels or shaping dynasties, this bundle lets you craft your own path to glory. It’s time to go from humble hut to historic marvel — one brick (or gnome) at a time!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/56328/EcoGnomix___Chinese_Frontiers/

notes.title: 🌊 Swim with us toward World Ocean Day Festival and help us save marine life! 🐳
notes.content:
The ocean is cruicial for our entire planet's ecosystems, producing more oxygen and absorbing more carbon than all the forests combined 💧 This event is all about protecting it and its many incredible inhabitants. 

World Ocean Day Festival is an event by Games For Waves, gaming and streaming community created by Whale and Dolphin Conservation. The goal? To connect gaming industry with real-world conservation efforts. The festival kicks off today and Untold Tales joins in with EcoGnomix - Deluxe Edition and many other titles!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39873559/1100d557d97384564b6d41b5b928ce40cf02a4ba.png

🗓️ From June 5th to 12th, we're pledging 20% of our net profits to Whale and Dolphin Conservation and you get to purchase our games, EcoGnomix - Deluxe Edition included, at deep discounts. This year, every purchase WDC to protect the ocean and the seas from deadly lost and discarded fishing gear! 🛶🎣🐟

[previewyoutube=7TmAZSZtikA;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 🚨 EcoGnomix Update 1.2 is here! 🚨
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44313274/d4d833313ae6a36f46bd84eb49361b2ef16947de.png

We've been busy making improvements and fixing bugs to make your gnome adventures even better! 

Check out what's new:

Balance:
🔹 Bomb Gnome's base damage increased from 3 -> 4
🔹 Marksman's damage upgrade increased from 3 -> 4
🔹 Increased the probability of finding secret recordings
🔹 Increased the speed of production chains in the city

Bug Fixes:
🔸 Fixed an issue where the game could get stuck with the "Meat Shield" upgrade
🔸 Miscellaneous localization fixes
🔸 Fixed a bug where "Flight Crew" made gnomes immune to Scorpions, even on ground tiles
🔸 Fixed an issue where the "Map" ration sometimes didn’t work, allowing players to skip caves
🔸 Fixed double refunds on building destruction costs
🔸 Fixed a bug with upgrades gained through rations affecting gnome refund costs

Features:
🔹 The Healer's second upgrade has been reworked to cure poison instead of increasing health


Thank you for your feedback! 
Keep it coming as we continue to improve your EcoGnomix experience. 🧙‍♂️✨

notes.title: EcoGnomix Patch 1.1: Balance Update is here! 🌿✨
notes.content:
We’re happy to bring you our first update, filled with the highly requested balance changes along with fixes to the reported issues. We won’t make the intro too long, so you can jump straight into the full patch notes below and see what’s new!

NEW FEATURES

 Added unlockable "Upgrade Bans" that allow players to choose upgrades to exclude from Helena's shop

BALANCE

 Dry Canyon Boss now stays for 4 (up from 3) actions if it does not catch anything to devour
 Dry Canyon caves with a "food" map icon now have an increased number of oases
 Bug Rancher's bugs now yield 2 food when harvested (up from 1)
 Bug Rancher price increased to 10 (from 5)
 Reduced the number of bats spawned by Stringbloom (scorpion miniboss) from3 to 1
 Selling a gnome now refunds 50% of the costs of its upgrades in addition to the base gnome cost
 Scorpions can no longer attack flying gnomes with the "Flight Crew" upgrade
 Bat Nests can no longer spawn in completely inaccessible locations
 Increased the amount of "horns" dropped by bosses and minibosses
 Increased the Bombergnome's base damage to 4 (up from 3)
 Increased the damage on the Marksman's "Piercing" upgrade to 4 (up from 3)

BUGFIXES

 Fixed an issue where players could get stuck in Helena's shop if stealing from her
 Fixed a bug where Beaver Master, Alchemist, Bombergnome and Trapper would not work with the Socialite and Loner upgrades
 Fixed an issue where players would be sent back to the tutorial expedition if they quit the game during the first return to the city
 Stealing from Helena's shop is no longer possible during the tutorial
 Fixed "Delivery Service" description showing incorrect numbers
 Fixed an issue where statues could be built into the Warehouse in the city
 Fixed an issue where buildings would not get refunded if the build menu was opened while placing them
 Fixed an issue where it was possible to click a building hidden behind a UI button
 Fixed an issue where it was possible to click the "Next Cave" button while a turn was in progress
 Fixed an issue where the Trapper's traps would sometimes not react to newly spawned scorpions
 Fixed an issue where "Fire Weapon"and "Exterminator" would not trigger if the gnome with the upgrade did not perform the last hit
 Fixed an issue where changing resolution would not automatically change the UI scale
 Fixed an issue where the Craftsgnome's "Tilebreaker" upgrade could yield basic wood in biomes 2 and 3
 Fixed an issue where the game could get stuck if using the "Meat Shield" upgrade
 Various localization fixes (typos and missing translations)

We can’t thank you enough for sharing your feedback and suggestions with us. We’re thrilled to shape the game based on your input, and we hope these new changes enhance your experience, letting you explore the caves in ways you’ve never imagined before (or maybe you did and suggested it :D)!

Yours, 
Untold Tales and Irox Games

notes.title: EcoGnomix Soundtrack + interview with a GNOME?!💿 🧙
notes.content:
Hello Explorers! 🎩🧐


The Official EcoGnomix Soundtrack is arriving on September 30th, along with the game’s full release! 

We’ve asked one of our Gnomes, Gnorman, a couple of questions about the tunes, have a read: 


Interviewer: Welcome, Gnorman! It’s fantastic to have you here to chat about the EcoGnomix Soundtrack. How are you today?

Gnorman: *Weeee!* Hello! I’m doing gnometastic, thank you. I’ve been busy tending to mi garden and humming along to our new soundtrack. Heard mi neighbor was doing it too!

Interviewer: Well, your neighbor seems to have great taste in music then! Anyway, can you tell us a bit about your favorite track from the soundtrack?

Gnorman: *Hiihii*. Mi favorite track has to be Hit It In The Cactobulos! Mi little feet went *tap, tap, tap* within the first seconds once I heard it for the first time. See? Even now when I’m just thinking about the song! *tap, tap, tap* 

Interviewer: Oh my, you’re right! I get it though, it’s a great song! I’ve heard that each track has a unique story or purpose. What do you usually do while listening to The Mystery That Caught My Eye?

Gnorman: *Humh*. This one is a treat! We, gnomes, listen to it on our treasure hunting adventures. The track’s intriguing melody makes all of the treasures go *bling*, so we can spot it easily! *tehe*

Interviewer: Wow, I need that kind of song in my life too, haha. Can you tell me who composed all of the 15 EcoGnomix songs? 

Gnorman: *Yippie* Rumor has it that a HUMAN named Alec Shea composed the soundtrack, along with the help from Jeff Saxon (Whistling) and Mariya Anastasova (Vocals). But we, gnomes, don’t believe they’re human. Only gnomes could create such wonderful music and sounds. Have you ever heard a real human whistle THIS good? *Phhh*

Interviewer: Now that’s an interesting theory, hmm… Maybe I will have to do some research on it in the future. Well, looks like our time has run out, thanks so much for chatting, Gnorman! 

Gnorman: *Haww* That went fast! Thank you! We, gnomes, hope to see all of the Explorers tapping their feet along with ours to these wonderful tunes soon! Oh, here they go again *tap, tap, tap*! Gotta run! *whoosh*


And there you have it, Explorers – a gnome’s view of the EcoGnomix Soundtrack! 

We hope Gnorman’s toe-tapping enthusiasm has you excited for the game’s full launch and that the tunes will get your feet going too! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3216420/EcoGnomix_Original_Soundtrack/

See you around, 
Irox Games and Untold Tales

notes.title: EcoGnomix: New Demo Out Now for Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hello there intrepid explorers!

Are you ready for your next roguelite adventure? We've just updated and released our latest demo for EcoGnomix! Experience rogue-lite exploration with a city-building twist on top!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44313274/8419ec530b14307dfc227e56fd34a1ae65badf45.png

WHAT DO YOU DO IN ECOGNOMIX?
Get ready to lead your gnomes in the hunt for illicit treasures as you delve into underground exploration and aboveground expansion.

Send your team of specialized gnomes into a labyrinth of mystical caves. Gather resources, collect supplies, and fight off enchanted foes as you try to take your team of gnomes deeper and deeper in search of better treasures. 

Strategically pick and choose which gnomes to deploy. Manage your supplies carefully to be able to keep exploring. Then grow your gnome village and unlock permanent upgrades with the resources you bring back to the surface.

EcoGnomix is a quirky roguelite strategy and city-building game. Build a covert business empire, by looting the underground world with a team of gnomes. Combine upgrades strategically to help your gnomes survive an unlimited supply of mystical caves with unique flora and fauna.
Get ready to flex your strategic muscles and take on the challenge in this unique adventure, the future of our gnomes is in your hands!

[previewyoutube=FiRP8IzkaIo;full][/previewyoutube]

 Small gnomes that chop trees and hunt chicken
 Upgrade banners that combine in unexpected ways
 Countless caves with a lot of explorable content

 Roguelite style progression with permanent unlockables
 The urge to explore just one more cave
 Great gamepad support for lazy couch sessions
